newsitem.title: UK: UK shares start mixed ahead of UK PMI.
newsitem.headline: UK shares start mixed ahead of UK PMI.

text.p: The fourth quarter got off to a slow start in London with leading shares mixed at the start as economic reports on both sides of the Atlantic kept a lid on activity, dealers said.

With little lead from Wall Street overnight and corporate news scarce, shares tracked sideways at the start, with attention on the release of the UK purchasing mangers index (PMI) this morning and the U.S. National Association of Purchasing Managers (NAPM) index later today.
Shortly after the start, shares had edged cautiously higher and the FTSE-100 index was up 6.2 points at 3,959.9.
